name: player_sync_local_pose_from_root_node
description: Player::SyncLocalPoseFromRootNode copies the active player's root-node pose into player state, rebuilds the motion transform, and restores local lifecycle state.
known_limits: tier S verification is deferred to the Player camera/source-cluster pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x42b810 verifies loading the active save state through g_GameStateOrMapTable, gwObject3DGetPosition into playerState->worldPos, gwObject3DGetRotation into vehiclePitchRad/restartYawRad/vehicleRollRad, zMath::MatBuildEulerRotation3x3 into motionBasis, mirroring worldPos into motionBasis translation, lifecycleState = 1, and copying the 0x30-byte motion transform into previousTransform. The native smoke covers pose extraction, transform rebuild, translation mirroring, previousTransform copy, and lifecycle state update.
